svg.title: One RCON packet, byte by byte
svg.text: One RCON packet, byte by byte
length: how many bytes follow it (33)
request id: the server echoes it back in its reply
type: 3 = log in with the password, 2 = run a command, 0 = reply
The reply uses the same frame: type 0, same request id, the result as the body.
